# IMPLEMENTATION_PLAN_TEMPLATE.md

## Purpose

This document defines the standard implementation planning format that must be completed before any development work begins.

No coding should start until this document has been completed and approved.

---

# Phase Information

Phase Number:

Phase Name:

Target Release:

Owner:

Date:

---

# Executive Summary

Provide a concise summary of:

- What will be built
- Why it is being built
- Expected business outcome

---

# Scope

## Included

List all functionality included in this phase.

---

## Excluded

List all functionality explicitly excluded from this phase.

---

# Requirements Mapping

| Requirement ID | Description | Included |
|----------------|-------------|----------|
| FR-XXX | Requirement Description | Yes/No |

---

# Technical Approach

Describe:

- Architecture changes
- New modules
- New services
- UI changes
- Backend changes

---

# Files To Create

Example:

- frontend/src/components/...
- backend/services/...

---

# Files To Modify

Example:

- App.tsx
- validation_engine.py

---

# Dependencies

## New Dependencies

List:

- Package
- Version
- Purpose

---

## Existing Dependencies Impacted

List impacted packages.

---

# Risks

| Risk | Impact | Mitigation |
|--------|--------|------------|

---

# Testing Strategy

## Unit Testing

Describe coverage.

---

## Integration Testing

Describe coverage.

---

## Manual Testing

Describe validation approach.

---

# Documentation Updates Required

Update:

- Architecture docs
- Phase docs
- Handoff docs

- Release notes

# Acceptance Criteria

List measurable outcomes required before completion.
